Commentary.Commentary: We are back. Ireland need 448 runs to win. Take two for them. Can they show a much better performance this time? Time will tell.
...THE CHASE...

Lorcan Tucker showed some promising signs as he started Day 3 by hitting a flurry of boundaries. However, not for long as Sri Lanka took the last three remaining wickets quickly and now Ireland have to follow-on with 448 runs to win. A big task for them as the ball has started to turn dearly. Stay tuned.

A sensational performance by Sri Lanka. Everything is going as per planned for them. Firstly, they have notched a humongous total for Ireland to work it out but Sri Lanka have blossomed with the ball now, putting Ireland in serious trouble. There is nothing to talk about for Irish Team. They were trapped in Prabath Jayasuriya's spin web who took seven wickets alone.

OUT! LBW! THREE REDS! Tossed up, around off, McBrine defends with his bat and pad together. An appeal for LBW but the finger stays down. Sri Lanka thinks it is pad first and they take it upstairs. Yes, it is the pad first. Ball Tracking shows three reds and that will do for the Lanka team. IRELAND ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 143.

Hello and welcome to the action of Day 3 between Ireland and Sri Lanka. The hosts are in a commanding position as they have done an excellent job so far. Starting with the bat, they have post a humongous total on the board and in reply, Ireland have already lost 7 wickets. Tucker and McBrine are the last known batter out there and have an uphill task from here on for them. A big partnership is needed between them as Ireland still trail by 474 runs. Stay tuned for more updates.
...Day 3, Session 1...

Ireland still trail by another 474 runs and they need another 275 to avoid a follow-on. That seems very far away, they will need this two to play a knock of a life time if they are to even get close to avoiding a follow-on. Sri Lanka on the other hand, will probably want to get the remaining wickets quickly and then we will have to see if they do enforce the follow-on if given a chance. Join us for Day 3. The action begins at 1000 IST (0430 GMT). Till then, goodbye and take care!

Yet again it is a day which has been dominated by the hosts and they are well, well ahead in this game! It all began with Dinesh Chandimal and Sadeera Samarawickrama scoring tons before Sri Lanka declared 9 short of 600. Then Vishwa Fernando got two in no time. There though was a fightback from Harry Tector and James McCollum. The two 70 with both getting off to starts but once Harry Tector fell, it was a procession. Prabath Jayasuriya ran through the middle order and has claimed a fifer. At one stage Lanka had a chance to bowl Ireland out before Stumps but Lorcan Tucker has shown grit and he got good support by Andy McBrine and the two have ensured there were no more wickets to fall on Day 2.
On middle, Andy Balbirnie rocks back and keeps it out. THAT WILL BE STUMPS ON DAY 2!

Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the final session! Harry Tector and James McCollum will resume their innings. Prabath Jayasuriya to continue.
... DAY 2, SESSION 3 ...

Sri Lanka will be very pleased with the work they have done with the ball in the little time they had before the Tea interval! They got two wickets and both fell to Vishwa Fernando in his first over itself. After that though, Harry Tector and James McCollum have batted with intent and have managed to score freely. However, they need a massive partnership as they are still well, well behind in the game. Lanka on the other hand, will need to continue to hit the right lines and lengths and be patient. The wicket is not offering a lot as of now so the question is, can the Irish batters cash in? We will find out after the break. Stay tuned.

Commentary.Commentary: That was close too! This starts outside off and comes back in late. Harry Tector leaves it alone. It just goes past the pad.

Commentary.Commentary: OUT! TAKEN! That is a sharp, sharp catch! Nishan Madushka, you beauty! Two in the over for Vishwa Fernando and this is a big one. Slightly unfortunate but Lanka won't care! On the pads, this is worked off the pads. It is off the middle, it hits the short leg fielder's shoulder, then the chest and lobs up kindly, Nishan Madushka takes it. Ireland in big trouble.
Commentary.Howout: c Nishan Madushka b Vishwa Fernando

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Off the mark in style! This is outside off, Andy guides it past point and this one races away to the fence.

Commentary.Commentary: BEATEN! That is a beauty! Length and around off, this is angled away. Andy Balbirnie is beaten as he pushes at it.

Commentary.Commentary: OUT! TIMBER! What a delivery that is! Especially first up, Murray Commins will be wondering, why him? He walks back on the very first ball he faces. This is angled into the off pole, it lands and then moves away. Murray Commins looks to defend but the ball goes past the outside edge and clips the off pole. Early wicket for the hosts.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Vishwa Fernando to Murray Commins, OUT! b Vishwa Fernando.

Commentary.Commentary: A loud appeal but turned down! Sri Lanka review but that seems to be sliding down leg. NOT OUT! That is going down leg! Sri Lanka lose a review in the first over itself. This time Asitha Fernando gets the ball to tail back in. James McCollum looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Testing first over then from Asitha Fernando!
